item.title: Lockheed Martin appoints Jeremy King as Chief Executive Australia and New Zealand
item.description: CANBERRA, Australia, 12 January 2025 –Lockheed Martin today announced that Jeremy King, former head of Joint Aviation Systems for Defence Capability Acquisition and Sustainment Group, will assume the role of chief executive for Australia and New Zealand. item.title: Beretta and Garmin Introduce the MARQ Commander (Gen 2) Beretta 500 Limited Edition Smartwatch
item.description: Accokeek, MD (January 14, 2026) – Beretta, the world’s oldest firearms manufacturer celebrating its 500th anniversary, is teaming up with Garmin, a global leader in GPS and smartwatch technology, to introduce the MARQ® Commander (Gen 2) Beretta Edition. item.title: RENK America Awarded US Army Contract with Potential Value of Up to $75.5 Million
item.description: Muskegon, Michigan, January 12, 2026 – RENK America today announced the award of a U.S. Army contract with a total potential value up to $75.5 million over a five-year period.
